ICS 23.100.10MED 20Reaffirmed 20221. SCOPEThis standard (Part 1) provides the technical requirements for horizontal centrifugal pumps non self-priming type, for handling clear, cold water for agricultural and rural water supply purposes.2. REFERENCESThe Indian Standards listed at Annex-A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
